jobs.occupation: International Customer Success Manager for a Copenhagen grid-tech start-up
jobs.description:
Are you a customer-facing project manager who thrives on paving the way to success for B2B customers? Do you speak fluent German and English – and perhaps Spanish/Italian? Do you see yourself in a fast-growing start-up with an international team that is securing critical electrical infrastructure?

Then you could be Oktogrid’s new Customer Success Manager!

About Oktogrid

Oktogrid helps secure critical infrastructure by bringing power transformers online for higher reliability and a more sustainable operation. Oktogrid’s sensor solution significantly accelerates the path to getting access to the right data to support operators with the necessary insights for their decision-making.

Founded in 2020. Oktogrid has the continued backing of major European investors, including ABB Electrification and Elewit Ventures, and works with a wide range of grid operators across Europe. The company has 14 employees, most of whom are based at the Copenhagen office, with sales colleagues based in Germany and the Netherlands. Oktogrid also works with an international development team. English is the company language.

About the role

Reporting directly to the CEO, who also heads up sales, you will ensure that Oktogrid’s customers get off to a strong start and support them on their journey as they continue to benefit of the value from the solution. As the Customer Success Manager, you will follow each new customer closely throughout the first 3-9 months – from installation workshops to confidently onboarding onto the Transformer Intelligence Platform.

You will remain their trusted point of contact for the entire customer journey, while your experience in project coordination will ensure that the right expertise from your colleagues is involved whenever needed. Your job is not to acquire new customers, but to build strong relationships with existing ones, identify new needs and plant the seeds for further collaboration. You will be based at the Copenhagen office, with occasional travel.

Your primary responsibilities:

• 
Running a structured onboarding process for new customers – from project kick-off workshops to onboarding onto the Transformer Intelligence Platform

• 
Following up closely with customers and holding regular check-ins to ensure that they get the value they expect

• 
Owning a portfolio of Danish and international customers, with a focus on German-speaking markets

• 
Engaging with a rich map of stakeholders within each customer organisation – for example, the operations managers in each region – so that the solution becomes part of their day-to-day work

• 
Bringing in Oktogrid’s technical experts when customers need in-depth answers about transformers, deeper data analytics or software integrations

• 
Identifying new needs and opportunities – such as additional analytics modules and reports – and passing them on to the product and operations teams

• 
Capturing customer feedback and success stories for Product and Marketing

• 
Building and continuously improving Oktogrid’s Customer Success process and playbook

About you

A background in utilities or within energy is a plus, but not a requirement – Oktogrid’s experts are at hand when in-depth expertise is needed. What matters most is that you are excellent at building trust, maintaining close dialogue with customers and picking up on when to involve your extended team at Oktogrid. Having previously worked within energy, telecoms, IT, SaaS or other B2B industries in which you have delivered complex solutions to large customers are relevant fields of experience. We envisage that you have:

• 
5-10 years’ experience in Customer Success or related customer-facing roles with B2B customers

• 
Experience of working with structured customer processes – ideally gained in a medium-sized company where you have had broad responsibility

• 
Experience in delivering complex solutions and managing long-term customer relationships, rather than having ambitions of driving transactional sales

• 
Technical understanding and the ability to explain complex solutions clearly to expert as well as non-expert stakeholders

• 
A proactive approach – you bring your own ideas to the table and take ownership of improving the way things are done

• 
Genuine curiosity about customers’ needs – you spot opportunities that create further value for them

• 
The drive to succeed in a fast-growing start-up as part of a high-performing, international team – and a preference for working from the office in close contact with customers and colleagues

• 
Fluent in German and English, written and spoken. Spanish and Italian would be a strong advantage, as many customers prefer to communicate in their own language

• 
Experience with utilities and an understanding of asset management practices would be an advantage, but is not a requirement

• 
A valid permit to live and work in Denmark (EU/EEA citizenship or a Danish work permit)

Oktogrid offers

• 
A key role with real influence in a company actively driving a meaningful climate impact

• 
Office-based work with flexible working hours, the option of working from home one day a week and a partly paid company lunch scheme every day

• 
A modern office space in Copenhagen at the border between Vesterbro and Frederiksberg, located close to green areas and a vibrant hub where innovation meets great city culture

• 
A salary based on qualifications, and a company-wide bonus scheme

Interested?

Apply as soon as possible by clicking the application button and uploading your CV and, if you wish, a cover letter, both in English.

If you have any questions, please contact Martin Nielsen, Headhunter & Partner at Landau Headhunting, on +45 8122 8180. Landau Headhunting is managing the recruitment process on behalf of Oktogrid, so please direct all enquiries to us. We will review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

We look forward to hearing from you! Read more about Oktogrid at https://oktogrid.io

Do you want to help shape smart metering products and solutions that accelerate the green transition?

To do so, you will be responsible for driving the commercial aspects of our product portfolio, including product launches and lifecycle management.

More specifically, you will be:

• Driving product discovery and portfolio optimization projects in close collaboration with our customers, Sales and Marketing

• Owning the business case and commercial roadmap for hardware products, including pricing, to ensure profitability and market fit

• Working with colleagues across the organization, training Sales and Customer Support to succeed

You will be at the forefront of decision-making, steering the direction of our products and solutions. In this role, you will have the mandate to act, and the responsibility needed to make impactful decisions that help our customers adapt to a more sustainable future.

**Meet your future team

**With direct reference to Senior Manager, Commercial Product Management, you will become part of a team of highly skilled colleagues who work every day to bring smart metering solutions and services to our markets. The Commercial Product Management team combines strong commercial capabilities with a solid technical understanding of our solutions to drive profitability and help our customers succeed in energy efficiency and the green transition.

The team is part of the Product Management organization for Heat/Cooling products and solutions and brings together colleagues with strong technical, commercial and strategic expertise. Department: Operations (Engineering Services & Customer Support)

Location: Copenhagen

**Description

**At Factbird, we help manufacturers see what’s really happening on their lines, so they can make better, faster decisions. Our plug-and-play hardware and cloud platform turn live production data into clear insights, and we’re scaling fast across sites, teams, and countries.

We’re looking for a hands-on Senior IoT Solutions Engineer to join Engineering Services, the team that takes on the technical problems that fall outside what our product and Support handle today. You’ll look at a PLC, a sensor, or a 20-year-old CNC and work out how to get its data into Factbird. Sales and Support turn to you when the answer is “it depends,” and you turn that into a clear yes, no, or “here’s how.” Then you write it down so the next person doesn’t need to ask.

****About the role

**Engineering Services solves the hardest technical problems, documents them, and shares the knowledge, so Factbird gets smarter and the same problem doesn’t come back. You’ll answer feasibility questions before deals close, design and build custom solutions, and fix the cross-domain problems no other team can place.

**

The team mission we are on: Engineering Services is a small team of experts finding solutions to a wide variety of challenges. In pre-sales we are supporting our AE's and Solution Consultants with feasibility testing the most complex customer setups or requirements. Often directly with the customers and their technical teams. In post-sales we collaborate with Cloud, FW and HW teams, and build and support a range of custom solutions. Our core mission is to increase documentation, standardization and empowering our colleagues in both pre- and post-sales roles to server the customers in the most technical cases.

**What You'll Do

**

• Answer feasibility questions from Sales: can we connect this machine, PLC, or sensor, and how

• Design and build custom solutions: logic boxes, signal converters, IO-Link modules, EDGE flows, and Factbird® powered by OMRON NX1 programs that fill gaps the cloud platform can’t handle yet.

• Design the integration: map the customer’s OT/IT environment and plan the data sources, tag structures, transformations, and security.

• Root cause troubleshooting in live production. Smaller share of time, highest stakes

• Document everything you build and fix: Solution Records, runbooks, and wiring guides for customers and internal teams, clear enough that someone else can pick it up. Version and back up every configuration.

• Bench-test hardware before it ships, test the full data flow end to end (including failure recovery and restarts), and hand hardware to Logistics with a clear packing list.

• Integrate customer systems through Kepware, Ignition, OPC UA, MQTT, EtherNet/IP, Modbus, and Node-RED.

• Share what you know: help Support, Solution Consultants, and Hardware handle more on their own.

• Streamline as you go: spot repeat work and clunky processes, and fix them or flag them. Build templates and scripts that make the next delivery faster.

• Turn repeat workarounds into product input with a business case, so the workaround can disappear.

• Join customer and prospect calls as the technical voice alongside Solution Consultants and Account Managers.

**About you

**You’re an experienced industrial automation engineer, as happy with a screwdriver as with a terminal. You know how factories work, and you’re comfortable saying “not directly, but here’s the route.”

You document like the next person depends on it, because they do. You can’t leave a clunky process alone: you always have an eye on how to make things simpler and more repeatable.

You’re flexible and self-directed: you take a high level of accountability and ownership. You can prioritize and deliver without daily supervision, and you troubleshoot systematically when things get ambiguous. The work changes week to week, and the team’s shape will keep evolving as Factbird grows. You’re happy to do what’s needed today while helping move things in a more scalable direction.

You love being the expert, but you equally love teaching others and making the teams around you smarter. And most of all, you care about making the answer simple for whoever asked.

Requirements:

• A bachelor's degree in automation, electrical engineering, mechatronics, or similar, or equivalent hands-on experience.

• At least 5 years in industrial automation or controls engineering, including hands-on work on the shop floor (7+ years preferred).

• Hands-on PLC experience with at least one major vendor, e.g. Siemens, Omron, or Rockwell/Allen-Bradley.

• Solid understanding of industrial protocols, e.g. OPC UA, Modbus, EtherNet/IP, MQTT.

• Working knowledge of sensors and signals, like digital, analog (4–20 mA, 0–10 V), IO-Link, PNP/NPN, and energy metering.

• Root cause analysis across hardware, networks, and software in live production environments.

• Field experience commissioning or troubleshooting equipment in live plants.

• Comfortable troubleshooting site networks, e.g. IP setup, routers, SIMs, and firewalls.

• A clear communicator in English who can explain technical trade-offs to non-engineers.

• A strong documentation habit: when you build it, you write it down.

**Why Factbird?

**People are at the heart of everything we build. We believe great products come from empowered teams — and we work hard to create an environment where you can do your best work and have space for life beyond it.

Here's what you can look forward to:

• Flexible working hours: We trust you to manage your time. Life isn’t one-size-fits-all, and neither is work.

• Competitive salary: We offer compensation that reflects your skills, experience, and impact.

• Internet reimbursement: Stay connected and productive, wherever you choose to work from.

• Thoughtful, human onboarding: We’ll support you step by step, giving you the context, tools, and guidance you need to feel confident from day one.

• A career path that grows with you: Through bi-yearly Individual Development Plan conversations, we’ll work together to shape a career journey that fits your ambitions.

• Company-wide kickoffs & team days: We regularly come together across teams and regions to connect, celebrate, and align on what’s next.

• A global, inclusive culture: We’re proud of our diverse backgrounds and perspectives — and we actively celebrate them in how we work and collaborate.

**We’d love to hear from you

**If this role feels like a match, we’d be excited to hear from you and explore how you could help shape the future of data collection and production monitoring at Factbird.

And if someone in your network comes to mind who might be a great fit — feel free to share this opportunity with them.

Have questions? You can always reach out to Khristel, our Global Talent Acquisition & People Operations Lead at **khma@factbird.com

**_At Factbird, we believe that great work starts with people feeling respected, valued, and included. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

__All employment decisions at Factbird are made based on business needs, role requirements, and individual qualifications, without discrimination based on gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital or family status, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected under applicable European and local employment laws.

_We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make our teams stronger and our work better. We warmly encourage all qualified candidates to apply and to bring their whole selves to Factbird.

**Job Title: Global Service Specialist – DO/EIMCO, Flotation, PCV, DSG

****Position Summary

**FLS is seeking a highly skilled and professional Global Service Specialist to support the erection, installation, pre‑commissioning, commissioning, and operational startup of commercial and industrial separation equipment. This role focuses primarily on mechanical work and Installation & Commissioning (I&C) activities for thickeners and flotation cells, with additional responsibility for equipment such as clarifiers, cyclones, pumps, reactors, and agitated tanks.

The Global Service Specialist serves as FLS’s primary onsite representative and is responsible for delivering high‑quality technical service, maintaining strong customer relationships, and ensuring safe and efficient project execution. This position requires extensive international travel and the ability to work independently under demanding conditions.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Execute onsite erection, installation, alignment, and commissioning of mechanical systems and I&C activities for thickeners, flotation cells, and related separation equipment.

• Lead pre‑commissioning and commissioning processes to ensure equipment meets design, safety, and performance requirements.

• Support operational startup, troubleshooting, and optimization of equipment performance.

• Conduct inspections, testing, calibration, and verification of mechanical and control‑related systems.

• Coordinate onsite project activities, schedules, and resources to ensure timely completion.

• Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, and project management teams to resolve technical issues.

• Prepare accurate and professional documentation, including installation records, commissioning reports, and service summaries.

• Maintain compliance with all safety, quality, and regulatory standards.

• Serve as the primary onsite point of contact for customers, providing training, guidance, and technical support.

• Represent FLS with professionalism and integrity in all customer interactions.

**Qualifications

****Required

**

• Strong mechanical background with hands‑on experience in Installation & Commissioning (I&C) of industrial process equipment.

• Experience with thickeners, flotation cells, clarifiers, cyclones, pumps, reactors, or similar industrial equipment.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently and make informed decisions under pressure.

• Strong project management skills, including planning, coordination, and documentation.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce high‑quality technical reports.

• Ability and willingness to travel internationally up to 70% of the time.

• Professional demeanor with the ability to represent the company effectively onsite.

**Preferred

**

• Experience in commissioning or startup of industrial process systems.

• Background in mining, minerals processing, water treatment, or heavy industrial environments.

• Multilingual capabilities or experience working in multicultural settings.

• Ability to meet all medical and physical fitness requirements necessary to obtain work authorization for high‑altitude job sites.

**Competencies

**

• Technical proficiency in mechanical systems and industrial equipment

• Strong problem‑solving and decision‑making abilities

• Customer service orientation

• Professional communication and reporting skills

• Ability to perform effectively in high‑pressure environments

• Self‑motivation and independence in field operations

We offer all employees access to a dedicated recognition platform, empowering you to celebrate achievements, share appreciation and stay connected globally.

**Your impact begins here

**As Safety Surveillance Principal Process Specialist, you will keep Safety Surveillance ready for every audit and inspection, and make sure the way we monitor safety information keeps pace with legislation. You will be a highly visible process expert: leading our contribution to inspections, co-driving regulatory surveillance and shaping how we integrate processes after acquisitions. Your work keeps surveillance of Novo’s marketed and developmental products compliant, simpler and focused on the work that adds most value.

**What You’ll Bring

**You know drug safety from the inside, and you know what it takes to get an organisation ready for an inspection. You will also bring:

• A Master’s degree in Life Sciences, such as Pharmacy, Medicine, Veterinary Science or Biology, or a related field.

• At least 5–7 years of experience in pharmacovigilance, including supporting safety activities in clinical trials.

• Hands-on experience facilitating inspection set-ups, training colleagues and preparing an organisation for audits and inspections.

• Expertise in Safety Surveillance processes and an enterprise mindset: you understand the end-to-end process and can turn complex internal and external requirements into practical ways of working.

• A solid background in handling deviations and implementing process changes.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage and influence senior internal stakeholders and external parties, and a collaborative mindset across functions and geographies.

• Resilience and a calm demeanour in a very busy environment, with the ability to multitask and prioritise your workload through complexity and challenge.

**Desirable, But Not Essential

**Experience in process management and project management.

**What You’ll Do

**You will be a recognised expert in key Safety Surveillance processes, helping the team work with greater simplicity and focus. The role covers a diverse range of tasks, and you could be part of an inspection from day one.

• Lead audits and inspections: coordinate Safety Surveillance contributions, prepare colleagues for interviews, ensure high-quality responses and keep oversight of findings and the associated corrective and preventive actions.

• Act as Process Expert for the signal management process and co-drive the Regulatory Surveillance process, ensuring full compliance with applicable legislation.

• Handle deviations and change requests in close collaboration with colleagues in Safety Surveillance and other relevant functions.

• Support integration and acquisition activities by helping integrate pharmacovigilance processes and systems following company or product acquisitions and mergers.

• Contribute to process improvement projects aligned with our strategic objectives, using your end-to-end view of Safety Surveillance.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join the Safety Surveillance Centre of Expertise, a team of five engaged and skilled colleagues within Safety Surveillance, and report to the Director of Safety Surveillance Centre of Expertise.

Safety Surveillance is a department within Global Patient Safety in Research & Development, with departments in Bangalore, India, and Boston, US. Together, we are globally accountable for surveillance of all safety information for Novo’s marketed products and products in development. We also handle safety label updates, Risk Management Plans and aggregate reports.

You will work closely with colleagues across Safety Surveillance and partner with Global Patient Safety, other headquarters functions and affiliates during audits and inspections. When processes need to change, you will bring the right people together, create clarity on what needs to happen and help the team move forward with pace.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will have real visibility as a process expert, and the opportunity to influence how Safety Surveillance works and make a lasting impact. You will be trusted to take ownership, encouraged to make your voice heard, and supported by colleagues who give honest feedback and never compromise on patient safety or quality.

The pace is high and the work is varied. Through process improvement projects and a broad range of tasks, you will build new skills and deepen your understanding of safety surveillance end to end.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 847,000 to

1,245,100 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate's skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here

**Start now

**Your impact begins today, so apply by 17 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We are an equal opportunities employer and are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all applicants.

**The Role

**You will own and lead global communication strategy for our Urology business area, playing a central role in Ambu’s transformation toward more insight-driven, digitally fluent, and customer-centric marketing. Based at our headquarters in Ballerup, Denmark, you will work closely with other Global MarCom Managers, our Brand & Creation team, Digital Marketing Specialists, Global Product Managers, Medical Affairs, and local sales companies to develop customer-centric, insight-driven, and commercially impactful communication. Your primary team consists of downstream product managers and you will work together on the daily to drive the Urology business forward.

Drive commercial marketing and business impact You will develop and optimize communication throughout the customer journey and your ability to seek out insights, interpret limited data, and translate findings into impactful communication will be essential to our success. From ideation to execution, you’ll ensure alignment, consistency, and commercial impact throughout the customer journey.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Own and lead the development and execution of global communication strategy for Urology, with a strong drive to build data-based customer communication.

• Developing sales enablement materials and content that empower commercial teams and drive engagement with healthcare professionals.

• Collaborating closely with the Digital Marketing team to identify performance and adapt communications accordingly.

• Collaborate with the Brand and Creative team to deliver sales & marketing materials that are both on-brand and commercially effective.

**Commercial mindset, proactive and collaborative

**You are a data-driven, commercially minded marketer, motivated by the challenge of building this capability in a less mature environment. You understand customer journeys and develop communication strategies that optimize business impact, even when insights are limited. You are resourceful, curious, and proactive in seeking out insights, and you can turn even small data points into meaningful communication. You enjoy collaborating with others and are eager to help shape our data-driven future. You’re skilled at managing stakeholders and building alignment across global teams.

To succeed, you’ll need: **Skills

**_Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are however likely to succeed in this position if you have:

_

• A Master’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field

• 10+ years of experience in commercial marketing, acquired in corporate roles, agencies, or both.

• Proven commercial experience within MedTech or Pharma.

• A proven ability to connect marketing to business results through communication & channel strategy, and sales enablement.

• Driven, hands-on, and strong sense of ownership.

• Strong project leadership skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities across time zones and functions.

• A proactive mindset with the ability to drive transformation in how we engage HCPs and stakeholders

• Excellent communication skills in English (verbal and written)

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is on an ambitious growth journey, expanding globally and pushing the boundaries of innovation in healthcare. Here, your contributions will directly shape our success. You’ll work in an international head office with a collaborative, open culture—where ideas matter, and impact is visible. We offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits along with exciting job challenges and career opportunities contributing to your job satisfaction.

**When to apply

**If you are ready to apply for the position, please apply. Your application will be treated confidentially.

Success in this role requires strong stakeholder management capabilities, sound technical judgement, and the ability to balance operational, commercial, and safety considerations.

You will drive the development of the traverse equipment roadmap, monitor fleet performance, and lead continuous improvement efforts throughout the equipment lifecycle. By fostering collaboration, standardization, and the adoption of new technologies, you will help ensure that our traverse solutions continue to support safe and efficient offshore operations worldwide.

• Ability to convert operational challenges and user feedback into technical requirements, validation criteria, and improvement plans.

Shape the Future of Privacy

Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. Our customers build trust with their users through improved transparency and control to drastically improve marketing and monetization, while achieving full privacy compliance.

About the Office of AI

The Office of AI owns the strategy, governance, infrastructure, and enablement of AI across Usercentrics. We sit within the CTO office and work across all departments.

Mission: enable the entire organisation to adopt AI safely, responsibly, and effectively.

About the role

You are the senior technical owner of AI enablement at Usercentrics: the person who takes the hardest department AI builds, the deepest platform problems, and the technical bar the rest of the enablement track works to.

The role has two layers, and we mean both. At the department layer, you do what every AI Enablement Engineer does, prototyping and shipping AI applications for Finance, Legal, HR, Marketing, Customer Success, BI and beyond, but you take the hardest ones yourself and set the pattern the others follow. At the platform layer, you own the infrastructure that makes all of that possible: the LLM access gateway, RAG infrastructure, model operations, evaluation frameworks, and the engineering standards product teams build against.

What you would be walking into: a real internal AI platform already adopted across the company, the AI Hub, MCP servers, Claude connector delivery, a skill hub, usage analytics, and low-code automation. The next layer is largely open. A gateway, RAG infrastructure, model operations, and evaluation frameworks are the current candidates, and you would have a strong say in what gets built and in what order. Real adoption already exists, which is a rarer starting point than a blank slate.

The role asks for two things at once. You are a deeply technical engineer who can architect and build these systems hands-on, at the hardest end of the department builds and the platform layer both. And you build a technical community: you raise the bar across the Enablement Engineers and beyond through education, mentoring, and reusable patterns. If you only have one of these, this is probably not your role.

You will work alongside the AI Enablement Lead, who owns the non-technical adoption pillar (the champion network, AI literacy, and the cross-department use-case pipeline). Your focus is the engineering depth behind that pipeline, from the department app someone is using tomorrow to the platform layer that will still be standing in two years.

On the shape of it: this is a small, senior team today, four to five people, and growing on both the engineering and enablement sides. You would be the most senior engineer on the enablement track and the technical bar would be yours to set.

Requirements

What you will do

• Take on the hardest department AI application builds yourself, and set the technical pattern the AI Enablement Engineers work to

• Own the platform layer that supports every department build: LLM access gateway, RAG infrastructure, model operations, and evaluation frameworks are the current candidates, and you help decide what they are

• Own the internal AI marketplace: keep the cross-departmental AI apps secure, maintained, and governed as the number of them grows

• Own evaluation frameworks and the guardrails that let the team move fast without shipping unreliable AI: output quality, hallucination detection, regression testing

• Set the engineering standards and integration patterns for AI that product and department teams build against

• Raise the engineering bar across the org. Run technical education and enablement for engineers, document reusable patterns, and mentor builders beyond your own team

• Partner with the AI Enablement Lead, Security, and Platform Engineering to ship AI capabilities that are safe, governed, and adopted

• Translate company-wide AI goals into concrete engineering roadmaps and measurable outcomes

What you bring

• 8+ years in software engineering, with significant time at staff level owning complex systems end to end

• Staff-level technical depth. You can own the most complex problems on the enablement track, from a department build to platform infrastructure, and lead by being the strongest engineer in the room

• Genuinely hands-on with AI. You have built and shipped production systems with LLMs, AI agents, RAG, or applied ML yourself, at both application and infrastructure layers

• A strong engineering foundation in distributed systems, backend platform design, and cloud architecture (Azure or GCP), with the judgement to set standards others follow

• A track record of mentoring senior engineers and unblocking ambiguous architecture without heavy process overhead

• A real technical-community or education background. You have taught, mentored at scale, run developer communities, written the docs, or evangelised technology to engineers beyond your own team

• Clear, direct communication, strong in async and written form. You align stakeholders across security, platform, and product without slowing the team down

Nice to have

• Experience with multi-cloud infrastructure (Azure, GCP) and modern DevOps practices

• Background in AI governance, evaluation, or responsible AI deployment

• Experience operating in a regulated or privacy-focused domain

• Recognition as a developer advocate, community leader, conference speaker, or similar (e.g. Google Developer Expert)

• Former founder or CTO experience, comfortable owning ambiguity end to end

Benefits

Why join Usercentrics?

• Joining Usercentrics means becoming part of a fast-growing, diverse and international team of tech enthusiasts and entrepreneurially-minded who build our success story together

• Company culture is important to us. We strive to continuously develop a positive, vibrant and inspiring environment that enables everyone to thrive both personally and professionally

• Get involved. We have plenty of initiatives and love to see people from all departments enthusiastically participating and shaping our future together in different cross-department projects

• Your work-life balance is important to us too. We offer flexible working hours, hybrid working, and the possibility of workcations (in accordance with our company policy)

• We always remember to have fun along the way, both in our day-to-day work and at our regular team events on site in our offices in Munich, Copenhagen, Odense, Lisbon and Prague, Buenos Aires and New York.

Some of our benefits

• 
Development budget for every employee: €800 per year

• 
Job-related language courses (English, German, Czech, Spanish, etc.): €350 per year

• 
Hybrid working policy with the option to take a workcation (up to 60 days per year)

• 
Online yoga sessions

• 
Events: team buildings, happy hours, parties/get-togethers, and occasional company-covered breakfasts or lunches (in-office, across offices, online, and in person)

• 
Gifts: we celebrate life and work milestones at UC (work anniversaries, new baby arrivals, and similar occasions)

• 
Snacks, fruit, coffee, and drinks in the office

ABOUT US

We are driven by our values #BeBrave, #BetterTogether, #LeadbyExample, #InnovateWithPurpose, #PassionForPrivacy, #GiveBack and #ComeAsYouAre. They show what we believe in and how we work. They help make our team special and guide us in everything we do. They're the heart of our company and inspire us to do our best every day.

We strive to create a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment (DEI) where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to reach their full potential. We believe that our different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are our greatest strengths — so we are committed to building with them as we foster innovation and drive our success.

We recognize that this is an ongoing journey. We commit to listening and to continuous learning, growth, and improvement. By embracing DEI principles, we will create a more just and equitable society, and we are proud to play our part in making this vision a reality.

We are #BetterTogether.
